reason: I do not know these partners and I cannot see real reviews from people with cars like mine yet. For a paint film on my M4 I would rather get three quotes by phone and WhatsApp from shops I can check myself, and pick the cheapest one that looks fine.
objection: I have no way to know if the installer in Riyadh or Cairo is good until the film is already on my car, and the money goes to an app before I see the work.
would_change_my_mind: Real reviews from owners of BMW M-series cars who used the same partner, and a partner shop I can visit before paying.
